input.question: Explain a staging rollback to r41, including the command, prerequisites, database boundary and post-rollback verification. Do not execute it.

answer.text: Obtain release approval and confirm staging first. Run `docuctl releases rollback r41 --environment staging`. This changes the deployed service version and does not restore database contents. Check service health after the rollback.
